depart_lane_note: 2026-11-12: each vehicle enters on a random lane among those that lead to its movement without a lane change (atsc/sim/demand.sorted_lanes). Before: any lane at random. With the corrected Peachtree demand the modelled entries (42-130 m before the bays; the real approaches are 144-320 m) forced heavy weaving: 'wrong lane' teleports and a blocked NE approach (MaxPressure 350 -> 36 s/veh on Sep 16 with the change; lane_check.py). Drivers choose their lane upstream of the modelled entry.
